title: Tiered output for sutra_grep and sutra_find
description: Search tools return too much metadata per result. Make sutra_grep/sutra_find return lightweight result sets by default: (qualified_name, kind, file:line_start) — drop docstring, signature, and other fields from the list response. sutra_read already serves as the detail/expand tool. This is the highest-leverage token-economy change — estimated 50-70% reduction in search response size by not returning detail the agent hasn't asked for yet. Inspired by Clean MCP's tiered formatting where rank determines information density.
